stages.test: END each stage; failure = seizure, 1 round helpless

death_rule: Only at intensity 5, after Delirium AND a failed TOU test AND nobody helped or tapered. GM warns at every stage.
halt: Healer/cleric/apothecary roll or a tapering half dose halts the clock for a day; companions can restrain and nurse.
spiral: Each month at intensity >= 3: WIL test or +1 intensity (max 5), no extra CP. Recovery: 3 months clean + sponsor/monastery + XP buy-off.

indulgence.note: Feeding the habit eases stress but costs a knight Virtue (drink/drugs break Purity).
